title: studio → pipelines: one input to an assistant chat
description: From API 1.44 (plan 18, 22.3). Written by studio's outbox in the transaction that stores the input (POST /v1/studio/assistant/threads/{id}/messages, or a chat ended for its summary); subject `cmd.assistant.turn` (stream CMD, durable `pipelines-assistant`, filter `cmd.assistant.>`: chats handled concurrently, each chat's inputs in order), Nats-Msg-Id `<thread_id>:<turn>`. pipelines runs the chat's LangGraph graph (thread `assistant:<thread_id>`, its state holding owner_id: an input whose owner differs is dropped): a message starts a turn, results and an answer resume the parked one (`Command(resume=…)`), summarize writes the chat's summary. Studio sets owner_id from its thread row, roles from the owner's token, `tools` from tools/catalog.json by those roles and the settings, `actions` from the screen's registered ones. A redelivered input (same turn) does nothing twice.

client_id.description: the tab whose actions this turn runs

tools.description: the tools of tools/catalog.json offered: surface assistant, the owner's roles; web_search only when it is on; look_at only when an ask workflow can run now

skills.description: from API 1.64 (contracts/README.md, Skills): the skills that are on, one line each in the prompt; use_skill reads one. Absent or [] = none (use_skill and read_skill_file are not offered)

plugins.description: from API 1.61 (contracts/README.md, Plugins): the plugins of kind assistant-tools that are on, as studio read them at this input; pipelines offers each tool as `<name>__<tool>` and calls `<url>/tools/<tool>` (plugins/manifest.schema.json toolCall). Absent or [] = none

actions.description: the screen actions offered: the screen's registered ones (empty for summarize)

settings.description: the admin's assistant settings at this input

source.description: the assistant's model: a local server or a remote provider

providers.description: the source's provider and the search provider, as they are now

search.description: the web search provider when web search is on (a key of providers, kind search); null when off

results.description: the parked turn's pending actions that never ran (did_not_run: the tab was closed), resumed before this message starts a turn

screen.description: the screen as the actions left it (after a navigate, the new screen)

oneOf.description: the chat ended (New chat, or 24 h after its last message): write its summary (one model call, at most 600 characters)
